title: Workload heatmap profiling and heuristic smoothing for continuous batching with guarded apply
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Build a robust engine that produces per-workload heatmaps and a compact set of smoothing heuristics to drive continuous batching parameter updates. The engine must generate safe, incremental configuration deltas that can be applied automatically under a guarded apply flow (shadow-evaluate -> canary -> guarded-apply -> automatic rollback on regressions).

Why: Current batching recommendations are noisy across diurnal patterns and sudden traffic shifts. Rather than replacing the recommender, this work focuses on (1) richer heatmap-based profiling to capture sequence length, arrival rate, and prefix reuse over time windows, (2) a smoothing step that prevents over-reactive parameter jumps, and (3) a guarded apply pipeline that validates candidate configs with shadow traffic and explicit safety thresholds.

Scope:
- Collection: extend runtime telemetry to emit per-model per-route time-bucketed metrics including sequence_length_distribution, interarrival_percentiles, prefix_cache_hit_rates, and tail_latency by bucket.
- Heatmap generation: offline and nearline process to convert metrics into compact heatmaps (hour-of-week x sequence-length buckets) with decay weights.
- Heuristic smoothing: define a small rule set that maps heatmap deltas to bounded parameter deltas (batch_size, max_batch_latency_ms, kv_cache_ttl) and a confidence score.
- Guarded apply flow: implement shadow-evaluate (no-impact scoring), canary rollout for 1% traffic, automated metrics checks (latency P95, cost/tokens, error-rate), and automatic rollback if safety checks fail.
- Telemetry and observability: dashboards and alerts for applied deltas, shadow evaluation results, and rollback reasons.

Non-goals: end-to-end fully adaptive autoscaling, model architecture-specific kernel changes, user-facing UI for manual tuning (this is an infra recommendation engine + apply pipeline).

Artifacts: design doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Heatmap+Smoothing+Design
Prototype PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4821 (WIP)
Telemetry dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/heatmaps/continuous-batching
acceptance_criteria: Runtime emits new time-bucketed telemetry for at least three pilot routes (chat-small, completions-api, embeddings-batch)
Heatmap job runs in nearline (<=10m lag) and produces compressed artifacts stored in S3 under s3://redwood-heatmaps/2026/
Smoothing heuristics produce bounded parameter deltas (max change per 24h: batch_size +/- 30%, max_batch_latency_ms +/- 20%) with a confidence score per recommendation
Guarded apply pipeline capable of doing shadow-evaluate + 1% canary with automated health checks and automatic rollback within 10 minutes on regression
Dashboards expose applied recommendations, shadow scores, and rollback reasons; at least two alerting rules created for regression and failed applies
